description:
The scope of proposed works includes:
Partial demolition and extension of the existing gable bay on the south elevation.  
New dormer on the north facing roof slope. 
New solar panels and an air source heat pump to replace the existing gas boiler. 
Replacement of existing windows on the main house. 
Landscaping improvements including the removal of several trees. 
Demolition of the existing garage outbuilding, 6.3m x 6.1m x 2.2M (approx. 84.5 cubic metres in volume).
Construction of a new Garden Room in the location of the former garage.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The rating level of the noise determined by the cumulative sound emissions of the plant to which this permission relates shall be at least 5dBA lower than the existing background noise level at any given time of operation. The noise levels shall be measured or predicted 1m externally to any window at the nearest residential facade and the measurements and assessment shall be made according to BS 4142:2014.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the commencement of any development above ground level, detailed drawings at a scale of minimum 1:20 of the following features shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority:- replacement and new windows- doorThe development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with  Arboricultural Method Statement prepared by Arbor Cultural Ltd  ( Ref AC.2026.0348) dated  8 February 2026 and Tree Constraints Plan Tree Protection Plan Drawing  Number TPP-01 Rev A  prepared by Arbor Cultural Ltd  dated 8 February 2026 . The approved measures shall be implemented prior to commencement of any work on site and maintained to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority until the completion of the development.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the implementation of the proposed development, details on the proposed PV Solar panels including dimensions, model, quantum and proposed layout at April Cottage, Coombe Hill Road are to be submitted and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority.Reason - To protect the character and amenities of the area in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM10 and DM12 of the Core Strategy

Within six months of cessation of the use and operation of the solar panels and equipment on this site, the panels and any external equipment and paraphernalia associated therewith shall be removed.Reason: To satisfactorily protect the character and appearance of the area. To comply with Policy DM 10 of the RBK Core Strategy. The retention of obsolete equipment would be harmful to the character and appearance of the immediate setting of the site.

The works shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the deposited Reasonable Exception  Statement compliant with Policy D12(A).Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire Safety) of the London Plan 2021.

The development hereby  permitted shall not  be occupied until details of secure cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to the development hereby approved have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted and shall thereafter be retained for use at all times.Reason  : To ensure the provision of the satisfactory cycle storage facilities and in the interests of highway safety in accordance with Policy DM8  (Sustainable Transport for New Developments) of the Core Strategy 2012.

The approved replacement windows at April Cottage, Coombe Hill Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7DU shall be installed to have the same window reveals/ recesses as the existing windows being removed and the retention of the existing soldier course header.Reason : To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan and policies CS8 and DM10 & DM12 of the LDF Core Strategy

The garden room accommodation hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling house as a single family dwelling unit known as April Cottage, Coombe Hill Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7DU and shall not be occupied as an independent or self-contained dwelling unit.Reason: To prevent the undesirable establishment of a separate independent unit of living accommodation in the interests of the residential amenity of the area and to ensure compliance with Policy DM10 of the Core Strategy (2012).

Prior to the installation and operational use of the proposed air source heat pump,  details on the proposed air source heat pump including location, dimensions, model, quantum and proposed layout at April Cottage, Coombe Hill Road are to be submitted and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority and the Air Source Heat Pump installed only in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To protect the character and amenities of the area in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy DM10 and DM12 of the Core Strategy.
